description_expanded:
In Seaside, just two streets from Town Square

Access to all Seaside amenities (swim, tennis, & fitness!)

4 bikes!

3 bedrooms (all with private balconies) plus 3rd floor loft, 3 full baths

Unique 3rd-floor loft area

Wraparound porch

Son Worshippers by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 That blue cottage with white railings and palms out front? Welcome to Son Worshipers, a three-level retreat, offering the Emerald Coast at its best. Set in one of 30A’s most iconic neighborhoods, this prime location is just two streets over from the bustling town square. You’re also close to the beach and the pool, so a quick hop on a bike? You’re ready for some Class A exploring! The small journey to the shore is part of the routine.

No packing the car, just walk out your front door and head to the sugar-white sand. A wooden path winds through the dunes before opening to wide white beaches and clear water that looks even better in person. Inside, the home feels relaxed, warm, and thoughtfully finished. Vaulted ceilings and natural light brighten the living area, while warm wood floors and comfy seating create an easy gathering space, perfect for a regroup after a full day outside. The kitchen is efficient, well-equipped, and ready for anything, from quick breakfasts to unhurried dinners. The dining table, a wonderful setting that tends to host meals that last longer than planned. Bedrooms are bright and peaceful, layered in crisp linens and soft light, each offering excellent privacy and its own private balcony. Bathrooms feature marble finishes and glass showers, while a reading nook and laundry round out the comforts. Up above, the third level offers a unique hideaway with two twin beds. Accessed by steep, ladder-type steps, this cozy loft has its own air conditioning, making it a cool and quirky retreat for the adventurous. With Seaside as your playground and every comfort at your fingertips, Son Worshipers is the ultimate backdrop for your perfect getaway. As always, the Oversee 30A team is nearby. Need anything? We’re here every day, plus a 24/7 line for the unexpected. Overview: - 3-minute stroll to the beach (Savannah Pavillion Access) - Access to Seaside amenities - Wraparound porch - 3 bedrooms (all with private balconies) plus 3rd floor loft, 3 full baths - 4 complimentary bikes - Private balconies for all bedrooms - Wi-Fi * Seaside is growing, please be aware of nearby construction. * Please note the following: The 3rd floor is accessed via steep, ladder-type steps and may not be suitable for all guests. It features its own A/C unit. Overnight: FIRST FLOOR Guest Bedroom: King bed, ensuite full bath, shower only, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bathroom, shower only, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, private bathroom, shower only, TV THIRD FLOOR - Common Area: Two twin beds, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
